description: Source code for PyTorch JIT fusion code generation, including tensor offset calculations, operator encoding, kernel generation for CPU and CUDA, and handling of tensor types and conversions.

methods.name: valueName
methods.description: Generates a string name for a Value based on its unique ID.

methods.name: scalarValue
methods.description: Converts a scalar value (int, bool, double) to its string representation, handling special cases for double.

methods.name: scalarTypeName
methods.description: Returns the device-specific string name for a given at::ScalarType.

methods.name: calcScalarTypeName
methods.description: Returns 'float' for Half and BFloat16 types, otherwise calls scalarTypeName.

methods.name: variableType
methods.description: Returns the C++ type string corresponding to a given C10 type.

methods.name: typeCastedValueName
methods.description: Returns a string representing the value casted to the specified output type if needed.

methods.name: encodeSpecialRHS
methods.description: Encodes the right-hand side expression for special ops like clamp.

methods.name: encodeRHS
methods.description: Encodes the RHS expression for a given node, supporting simple mapped ops and special cases.

methods.name: generateKernel
methods.description: Generates CUDA or CPU kernel code for a given graph, inputs, and outputs.
